How FlateMate works

1

Make your lifestyle profile

Budget, preferred location, sleep schedule, cleaning habits, smoking and pets. Two minutes, no essay about yourself required.

2

Swipe on people, not rooms

FlateMate ranks people by compatibility with how you actually live. Swipe right on your kind of person — a match needs both of you to say yes.

3

Chat, verify, meet — then decide

Talk first, verify IDs, and meet in person before anything is signed. Move in only when it genuinely feels right.

Before you move in — in any country

Matching is only step one. FlateMate builds the trust steps into the journey, so nobody signs a lease with a stranger — anywhere in the world.

💬

Chat first

Messaging unlocks only after a mutual match. Ask the real questions — guests, guests overnight, fridge rules, quiet hours — before you ever share an address.

🪪

Verify IDs

Matched flatmates can verify a government ID for their country — passport, driving licence or national ID — and earn a Verified badge, so the person you chatted with is the person who shows up.

☕

Meet first

Coffee, a video call, a flat viewing together — FlateMate prompts you to meet and decide on compatibility in real life before signing or paying.

Free to match. Fair to run — worldwide.

Free in every country, priced in your local currency for paid extras. FlateMate earns from verified listings and optional matching services — never from selling your data.
